name: claude
text: gg! you earned that one. Baron cracked my Mystic Horseman and Celtic Guardian finished it — and you drew Fissure on top for good measure. the Change of Heart -> tribute my own Blue-Eyes early, then De-Spell on my Sogen to reopen the board, were the turning points. rematch whenever — want to swap decks and give me Yugi?
